### Description:
##### Permission relationship
- **Sub-user vehicle authorization must be for the company to which the sub-user belongs or the subordinate company of the company to which the sub-user belongs. Vehicles cannot be authorized by the superior company**
- **Every time a company is added, a master account with the highest authority of the company must be added at the same time. It does not need to be able to see all vehicles in the vehicle authorization**
- **When a role authorizes a user, it can only authorize the associated role of the same level company. It cannot cross to the superior or subordinate company role, unless you click Global Share when creating a role (here it means that this role is shared with all users of the entire first-level company)**
- **The fleet can only be moved to the subordinate company of the company and its fleet. The fleets under the company can move to each other; vehicles can only be assigned to the fleet under the company**

##### Explanation of each operation menu
- **Fleet management: The fleet form has been added to manage vehicles. The fleet must be created under the company establishment and can be regarded as a group under the company**
- **User information: Add an account and assign this account the authority to add vehicles and view vehicles after logging in**
- **Role management: assign all detailed permissions that a company's role can operate, such as vehicle control, platform menu operations, etc., must be associated with the user**
- **Company information: a necessary condition for using the platform. When adding vehicles and other operations, a company must exist**

### Operation steps:
##### 1. WEB access
Use a browser to access the platform WEB address to enter the system. The access address is IP+port. For example: http://192.168.1.163:88
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=056a2a8c2f0383c33c1232ce4ac71f39)

##### 2. Add a company
Click Operation Management >>> Company Information >>> Add to create a first-level company
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=b25259fd94d7f55917c357df8782df9b)

3.Fill in the required items in the add interface: company name, main account, password and some non-essential information of legal person and contact person according to actual situation, and click Save.
The main account "test" of this first-level company is also added here, which has the highest operation authority of this company. At this time, the addition of a first-level company is completed
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=870dff70f84b7bb2055dfaa29496d402)
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=a68a3ef5aa6865bacdadbce65b6d1096)

##### 4. Add a vehicle
Click Vehicle Information>>>Add or Quick Add (Add is to add a single vehicle for more comprehensive information, Quick Add is to add multiple vehicles quickly)
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=96099d4c95b5fe34bc5933e672238545)

5.In the Add Vehicle Basic Information interface, fill in the required items: vehicle number, license plate color, company and some other information based on actual conditions Service expiration date, manufacturer and other information
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=61a095d0fc6b302b4184b80faeafe73b)

6.Click the "+" sign on the right side of the device number input box in the device information column to add a device. Click "+" to enter the quick add device menu, fill in the device number, device type, protocol type, manufacturer type, click Save to complete the device addition and management to this vehicle, fill in some other information according to the actual situation, such as channel parameters, IO input parameters, sensor parameters, etc., and click Save. This completes the vehicle addition and the addition of the device at the same time
Click the input box 2 on the left here to enter the associated device menu to associate the vehicle. At this time, you must first go to the device management menu to add the device first.
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=62d2ad97dc9aac39e40df274cdc5d02a)
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=98e286b77b01b3e9f9bd13d259d1d7d5)
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=bf45681f2a4843d07b12d5dbffc682b9)
The first-level company and vehicle addition is completed here. Use the "test" first-level account to log in and you can see all the added vehicles.

7.Add a subsidiary
Repeat the steps in 2 above to add a company to add a subsidiary. Select the parent company and click the newly added head office to save it.
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=4d2f948287a75218ca3df13f6340ef54)

##### 8. Add sub-users
Click User Information >>> Add, fill in the company, sub-user account and password and other required items with red stars
Click the "+" sign on the right side of the role name input box to add a role, fill in the role name, check some permissions required according to the actual situation, and confirm to save
Here, the sub-user addition is completed and the role addition is completed. If you click the input box, you will enter the associated role information menu. At this time, you must first go to the role association menu to create a new role information before you can associate it
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=70e15d975d50bd00ce8775cc82a2c555)
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=630d5a7c42855d7c31037a54f51f2c13)
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=0432267c398cd7be9e9054c9ddb72447)

##### 9. Sub-user vehicle authorization
In the user information menu list interface, click the sub-user human icon that needs to be authorized to come to the authorized vehicle list, select the vehicle that needs to be authorized and click the check box to check it Click Authorize or click the human-shaped icon on the right to authorize. This will complete the car authorization for this user. Log in again to this account to see the authorized vehicle
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=ce2138ac33c230e9263ab4971a55dbde)
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=f68aa7591dd8aa3e7555cb7ba464bf56)
You can also click the human-shaped icon in the middle of the vehicle in the vehicle information menu to authorize or cancel the authorization company
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=58d35dd0173367541ae97cb5f37af494)
